title: Reinstatement conditions after suspension or revocation
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 4.02(6) an applicant for personal registration renewal whose registration has been revoked, or suspended for between six months and two years, shall take and pass the MPJE and meet all conditions determined by the Board. Under 247 CMR 4.02(7) an applicant whose registration has been revoked or suspended for more than two years shall take and pass the MPJE and meet all other Board conditions, which may include taking and passing the NAPLEX.
exam_relevance: Tests the two-tier reinstatement ladder after discipline, where NAPLEX becomes available to the Board only beyond the two-year threshold.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

numeric_facts.fact: threshold at which NAPLEX may also be required
numeric_facts.conditions: revoked or suspended for more than two years

common_confusions: A disciplinary lapse follows a different ladder from a simple failure to renew.
NAPLEX is a possible additional condition only in the longer tier.
verification_notes: Read in the current official Board of Registration in Pharmacy publication of 247 CMR 4.00 on 2026-08-19 during Batch 3 tranche B3-A authoring under Issue #91. A fresh independent legal and full-bank realism audit is still required before release.
